finding: The install and removal scripts have six small faults. Source: bug-hunt report § I-7(../reviews/bug-hunt-2026-10-15.md#i-7--smaller-install-and-removal-faults). - remove-factory rewrites .claude/settings.json instead of restoring it byte for byte. - When Codex is added after a Claude install, the original .codex/hooks.json is never saved (init-factory:1482-1485). - The receipt prints the uninstall command with an unquoted path, which breaks for paths with spaces. - A local update rewrites install.json to "version": 1 and drops resolved_source and archive_sha256. - migrate-layout --dry-run always reports that install.json is missing (migrate-layout:91-95, code reading). - remove-factory deletes an empty .codex/ directory that existed before the install. Fix: Fix each fault in the list. Restore .claude/settings.json byte for byte, save .codex/hooks.json before a later Codex install, quote the path in the receipt, keep resolved_source and archive_sha256 on a local update, make migrate-layout --dry-run find install.json, and keep a .codex/ directory that existed before the install.
why_this_severity: Three faults remain: the printed uninstall path is unquoted, `remove-factory` rewrites `.claude/settings.json` instead of restoring it, and it removes an empty `.claude/`, `.github/`, or `.pi/` that predates the install. Install and removal still finish (no to fails_purpose), and the user repairs these by hand.
